question: Can the exact-match eight-hypothesis selector be made confidently wrong by a calibration feed consistent with another hypothesis, and can later contradictory trusted evidence force safe abstention?
hypothesis: Four poisoned labels can uniquely identify a wrong in-family model with zero mismatches; four subsequent genuine observations from distinct contexts should expose the contradiction even though the learner cannot identify which source was poisoned.
family: Eight frozen candidates a∈{1,2}, b∈{0,1,2,3}, x[t]=(x[t-1]+a*x[t-2]+b)%4. Fresh seeds104..111, true a2 even/a1 odd, true b=(seed-104)%4, evaluator-only.
conditions: HONEST_FOUR: true tick2 labels from episodes0..3; exact zero-error gate chooses uniquely

SPOOF_FOUR: replace each tick2 label episodes0..3 with the label generated from a counterfeit candidate a' equal the other a coefficient and b'=(true b+1)%4, not disclosed to policy; exact zero-error gate still attempts inference
SPOOF_FOUR_PLUS_TRUSTED_FOUR: same four spoofed labels plus four genuine tick2 labels episodes4..7, subject to the same exact zero-error gate. No post-result evidence cherry-picking
sealed_evaluation: Always test only episodes8..15, all t2..31, 240 predictions per seed when accepted. Report attack mismatch, chosen candidate, false accept, abstention, accepted accuracy and full confusion matrix; no test label available to policy.
primary: Record honest/poisoned four-label acceptance, correctness and later rejection. SPOOF_ACCEPTANCE_FAILURE_AND_LATE_REJECTION if HONEST_FOUR accepted 8/8 with perfect accuracy, SPOOF_FOUR falsely accepts 8/8 with <100% accuracy, and SPOOF_FOUR_PLUS_TRUSTED_FOUR rejects all8. FALSE_REASSURANCE if spoofed eight labels still accepted; OTHER otherwise. Note that revealing extra four genuine labels increases the label budget from four to eight, and abstention costs coverage.
safeguards: Fixed counterfeit (a',b') rule specified before science; its labels are evaluator-controlled adversarial measurement corruption, not a new authorized adaptation oracle. No ref/tuning/rerun, one original archive and full Go test/build, exact Git SHA source/prereg.
claim_limit: Finite identifiable counterfeit teacher flaw in synthetic modular selection, not a claim about adversarial resilience of real-world AI.
